result.title: Turkish Multimodal Video Fact-Checking: A New Dataset and a Comparison of Zero-Shot Agentic and Fine-Tuned Systems
result.comment: 11 pages, 3 figures, 5 tables. MSc dissertation, Queen Mary University of London, 2026
result.summary: Video-based misinformation spreads rapidly on social media, but almost all existing fact-checking systems focus exclusively on English text. Tools for low-resource languages such as Turkish are severely limited. In this work, we present TeViD (Turkish Video Fact-checking Dataset), to the best of our knowledge the first multimodal video fact-checking dataset for Turkish. We compiled the dataset from articles published by Teyit.org, an IFCN-certified organisation, and enriched it with translated Snopes articles and synthetic examples to reduce class imbalance. Building on TeViD, we develop two verification pipelines that share the same open-source base model. First, in 3MFact-TR (Pipeline 1), we adapt the multi-role 3MFact framework to Turkish with the Qwen2.5-7B large language model and the Qwen2-VL-7B vision-language model, and add three modules of our own: a semantic inconsistency checker, a 5W1H question manager, and a bilingual evidence retriever that excludes fact-checking sites to prevent leakage. Second, as our Fine-Tuned Model (Pipeline 2), we fine-tune a single Qwen2.5-7B with Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) to produce closed-book verdicts from the claim and the video's textual description. We report accuracy, macro F1, True class F1, and True class recall for both systems, together with ablation studies.

AI.brief_summary: 构建首个土耳其语多模态视频事实核查数据集 TeViD，并比较两种共享同一开源基座的验证流水线：多角色 agentic 的 3MFact-TR（含语义不一致检查、5W1H 问题管理、双语证据检索）与基于 LoRA 的闭卷微调模型。
AI.relevance_reason: 其闭卷微调仅用主张与视频文本描述产出判定，可作为核查「视觉旁路／视觉证据是否真正被使用」的对照线索；agentic 流水线的证据检索与问题管理也可能为证据获取与停止决策提供参照。
